test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: U, V, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre. U is sitting to the immediate left of W. X sits exactly in between V and Y. W and V are sitting next to each other. Who is sitting to the immediate left of U?
solution:
U, V, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre.

1) U is sitting to the immediate left of W and W and V are sitting next to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6aee27291936359ec179d6efc0a73b296be7f297a549a5e07bd5def8748690c.png] 

2) X sits exactly in between V and Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb5e3cc2b62e6911adfb940ad83973dcfea2b7ef1f36b9b2ab0df7ae71968863.png] 

∴ Here, 'Y' is sitting to the immediate left of U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Y".**
